name: Intel: Performance Data for Intel Data Center GPU Flex Series 170 (OpenVINO/TF/PyTorch CV table)
notes: Vendor CV-inference table measured 2023-10-24: OpenVINO 2023.2 / Intel TF 2.13 / Intel PyTorch 1.13 on 1x Flex 170 on Xeon 8360Y 2S-36C-72T, 128GB DDR4-3200, Ubuntu 22.04. Units: images/sec (ResNet-50/YOLOv4/EfficientNet/MaskRCNN int8-fp16) and iterations/sec (Stable Diffusion fp16). Vision-CNN numbers, NOT generative-token throughput - useful as the only published measured throughput series for this part.
